analyst.summary: Divi's Laboratories is a debt-free, best-in-class-on-regulatory-compliance Indian API and custom-synthesis (CDMO) manufacturer that delivered 13% revenue growth and 17% profit growth in FY26, with margins expanding through the year as pricing pressure from Chinese API competitors was offset by a shift toward higher-margin contract manufacturing. Its two main plants have clean recent USFDA inspection records and there is no live regulatory red flag. The concern is valuation: at roughly 75 times trailing earnings, the stock is priced for a much faster growth story (built around GLP-1-adjacent and other custom-synthesis contracts) than the company has yet confirmed - management describes that pipeline as 'strong interest,' not signed business, with commercialization still 12-14 months away. We rate it Hold: a quality, low-risk franchise, but not attractively priced at current levels, with the next results (expected early August 2026) the key near-term check on whether growth is accelerating enough to justify the multiple.
